The '''Escarte system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Keldrath sector/Legends|Keldrath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]].
